description: This file defines the OutpostsBucketArn class, which represents and parses Amazon S3 Outposts bucket ARNs. It includes methods for parsing ARN strings, extracting bucket and outpost IDs, and validating the ARN structure specific to Outposts buckets.

classes.name: OutpostsBucketArn
classes.description: Represents an S3 Outposts bucket ARN, providing parsing, access, and validation methods specific to such ARNs.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string into its components, including resource type and ID, and specific Outpost data.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the bucket name extracted from the ARN.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Returns the Outpost ID extracted from the ARN.

methods.name: parseOutpostData
methods.description: Internal method that splits the resource ID to extract Outpost ID, bucket label, and bucket name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ARN data, ensuring it conforms to the expected structure for S3 Outposts bucket ARNs.
